_schema.purpose: Conservative pattern list for beacon_approval_handler.is_completion_claim(). Used at EMISSION time by the bot's prose guard (beacon_telegram_bot._send_beacon_response) to catch a Beacon chat reply that asserts a COMPLETED dispatch/approval when NO APPROVAL_REQUEST marker was emitted in that turn (the 2026-06-03 deploy-notifier-ready-logonly phantom). Distinct from config/phantom-dispatch-claim-patterns.json: that file feeds the AFTER-THE-FACT detector (heal_phantom_dispatch_claim.py, ~10 min grace, task_id verification); this file feeds the PREVENT guard that intercepts before Larry sees the prose. Tuned tighter than the detector so it does not muzzle normal talk or brief-protected intent ('I'm dispatching X now'). All matches are case-insensitive substring. Revisit the pattern set if the detector logs real firings with phrasing these miss.
